Game Overview

In Color Patterns, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a vibrant journey with Color Patterns, a delightful puzzle adventure where kids unlock bridges by completing color sequences. Challenge young minds with increasingly complex patterns, encouraging logic and memory skills, all wrapped in easy touch controls and cheerful visuals. Help the friendly truck reach its destination!
